name: Ekma

queries.query: Ekma Saran Bihar official land records cadastral map Bhunaksha Bihar
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Bihar BhuNaksha cadastral viewer, Bihar Department of Revenue and Land Reforms, the Directorate of Land Records and Survey, and the national Bhu-Naksha implementation page. The current Bihar viewer exposes Bihar, Saran, Sadar, Ekma, and the village entry Ekma/एकमा (163).

queries.query: एकमा सारण बिहार भू नक्शा जमाबंदी आधिकारिक
queries.result: First-party Hindi discovery returned the same official Bihar BhuNaksha and Bihar Bhumi services. The official Hindi-facing material describes भू-नक्शा and जमाबंदी services; it does not itself expose a safe anonymous parcel vector response.

registryBasis: The official Government of Bihar BhuNaksha viewer is a public cadastral map service with a location hierarchy that was queried successfully through its current JavaScript-driven selectors: state Bihar (10), district Saran (17), subdivision Sadar (01), circle Ekma (06), and village Ekma/एकमा (0509; displayed as Ekma (163)). This evidences a local/state cadastral map custodian, but not open citywide parcel-vector coverage.

requests.outcome: HTTP page available; current JavaScript/configuration loaded from assets/misc/config.js and index.js.
TLS-verified public configuration inspected; SERVICE_PATH and COMMON_SERVER_PATH are same-origin empty prefixes.
TLS-verified viewer JavaScript inspected; documented REST endpoints include Levels, ScalarDatahandler, MapInfo and WMS routes.
state=10 returned the Bihar district selector including Saran (17).
OP=2 level requests returned public selector HTML; Saran/Sadar/Ekma and village Ekma/एकमा (0509; displayed 163) were confirmed. Survey choices SS/RS/CS and map choices were returned.
Bounded requests for the confirmed Ekma selections returned an empty response; no extent, CRS, GIS code, parcel ID or geometry was obtained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Government of Bihar BhuNaksha public cadastral viewer, with the Saran/Sadar/Ekma location path evidenced.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Location-selector coverage only; parcel-vector coverage not verified.

remainingUncertainty: The viewer schema and CRS are only partially visible in JavaScript; the extent endpoint returned no body for the confirmed location path. Native parcel identity, geometry response format, exact-point parcel relation, and citywide coverage remain unresolved. No absence inference is made.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
